# KMD Labs

> Geospatial R&D, Earth Observation & Scientific Geovisualization

KMD Labs is a scientific engineering and geovisualization studio that designs immersive, full-screen, GPU-accelerated interactive applications for complex earth system models, satellite remote sensing pipelines, and historical simulations.

## Interactive Projects

- [El Niño — Southern Oscillation (ENSO)](https://kmd-labs.org/el-nino/): Interactive 3D Pacific thermocline variability, Walker Circulation dynamics, and Niño 3.4 SST anomaly teleconnections. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/kmd-labs/el-nino)
- [Baltic Sea Drainage Basin (Watershed)](https://kmd-labs.org/watershed/): Interactive 3D globe of every river catchment draining to the Baltic Sea, the sea sub-basins they feed and the countries they cross, with guided tours, catchment statistics and a print poster maker (HydroRIVERS / HydroBASINS). [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/kmd-labs/watershed)
- [Golfstrom — North Atlantic Heat Engine](https://kmd-labs.org/golfstrom/): AMOC thermohaline circulation, Gulf Stream western boundary current meanders, and subpolar gyre heat transport simulation. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/kmd-labs/golfstrom)
- [Baltic Postglacial Reconstruction](https://kmd-labs.org/baltic/): 14,000-year Glacial Isostatic Adjustment paleogeographic reconstruction from the Baltic Ice Lake to the modern brackish sea. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/kmd-labs/baltic)
- [Viadrus AI (CASSINI EU Winner)](https://kmd-labs.org/viadrusai/): Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR interferometry & Sentinel-2 optical anomaly detection pipeline for early water network leak localization. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/kmd-labs/viadrusai)
- [Polis — Archaic Hellas Geosimulation (600 BC)](https://kmd-labs.org/polis-io/): DEM-based agentic city-state simulation of Aegean trade networks, maritime cabotage, and political geography. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/kmd-labs/polis-io)
